title: #225 Late Babies
prompt: In some countries, couples are having babies late in life. What are the reasons?

promptSegments.text: In some countries, couples are having babies late in life.

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.
requirements.vi: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng và nhất quán khi đề yêu cầu ý kiến.

requirements.en: Develop each main idea with explanation and an example.
requirements.vi: Phát triển mỗi ý chính bằng giải thích và ví dụ.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main reason couples delay having babies is due to focusing on their careers and building their financial lives first.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main reason couples delay having babies is due to focusing on their careers and building their financial lives first.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A good solution is for the government to provide better financial support to help new parents plan their family.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A good solution is for the government to provide better financial support to help new parents plan their family.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main cause for late parenthood is the desire to establish a career and achieve financial stability.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main cause for late parenthood is the desire to establish a career and achieve financial stability.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A practical solution is for governments and institutions to improve support systems for working parents.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A practical solution is for governments and institutions to improve support systems for working parents.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary cause for late parenthood is the emphasis on career establishment and financial security.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary cause for late parenthood is the emphasis on career establishment and financial security.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A practical solution involves implementing supportive workplace policies to help balance professional life and family planning.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A practical solution involves implementing supportive workplace policies to help balance professional life and family planning.

modelPlan.focus: Analyze the reasons behind delayed parenthood in some countries, focusing on socio-economic and lifestyle factors.
outline: Introduction: Present the trend of delayed parenthood and its significance.
Body 1: Discuss socio-economic factors such as career and financial stability.
Body 2: Explore lifestyle choices and work-life balance considerations.
Conclusion: Summarize the key factors and their implications.
keyArguments: Delayed parenthood is often linked to individuals prioritizing their careers and financial stability over starting a family early.
The desire for a better work-life balance and lifestyle autonomy also contributes to postponing parenthood.

plan.focus: Analyze the reasons behind delayed parenthood in some countries, focusing on socio-economic and lifestyle factors.
outline: Introduction: Present the trend of delayed parenthood and its significance.
Body 1: Discuss socio-economic factors such as career and financial stability.
Body 2: Explore lifestyle choices and work-life balance considerations.
Conclusion: Summarize the key factors and their implications.
keyArguments: Delayed parenthood is often linked to individuals prioritizing their careers and financial stability over starting a family early.
The desire for a better work-life balance and lifestyle autonomy also contributes to postponing parenthood.
